PUBLIC PORTFOLIOS

Follow the whales

Build your own watchlist of reporting institutions. Track filed holdings and share-count increases, with dates and source documents.

Coverage and reporting delays

Seven institutions are configured initially. “Follow all” means all covered managers, not every whale worldwide. Add verified CIKs in research/config.json to expand backend coverage. Following an insider filters the sampled purchase feed; it does not add complete coverage of that person. Private trades and undisclosed positions cannot be observed.

13F holdings can arrive up to 45 days after quarter end. Increased shares can reflect splits or transfers; they are not confirmed purchases. Amended periods are flagged and their comparisons withheld. Holdings show the top 30 share counts, not portfolio weights. Politician disclosures and copy trading are not connected.

Latest filing documents

Which setups survived costs?

Three fixed rules. First 60% of dates for selection, final 40% for historical evaluation.

Held-out equity · selected strategy

Equal capital per symbol; idle capital remains cash. Starting value = 1.

Execution assumptions

  • Signal at daily close; enter next session's open.
  • Exit five sessions after entry. One position per symbol.
  • 50 basis points per side; stress test at 150.
  • Long-only, fully cash-funded. No leverage.
  • Results include estimated costs, not guaranteed fills.
Repeatedly reviewing the same holdout can overfit it. Archived daily observations begin at installation; no forward profitability is established yet. Losing strategies remain visible.

Data health

Update cadence

GitHub Actions fetches data and reruns tests every four hours on weekdays. The page checks for the newest snapshot every five minutes while open. Prices use completed daily sessions, not streaming quotes.

View refresh jobs ↗

Research controls

The public repository stores market data only. No brokerage credentials, account balances, or trading permissions are used.

SEC requests identify this app using its public repository contact URL. An optional repository secret SEC_USER_AGENT can override the identity. Never paste credentials into this page.

Edit research/config.json in GitHub to change the watchlist or managers. The current universe includes candidates that may no longer trade or qualify; exclusions and retrieval errors stay visible.

Open source code ↗
No strategy can guarantee the highest return. Penny stocks can be illiquid, manipulated, diluted, or halted. This app measures historical behavior; it does not place orders.
